function BF takes nothing returns nothing
	local unit u

handlers.name: Vd
handlers.body:
function Vd takes unit u returns nothing
	local integer i=GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A10A')
	local integer j=GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A09L')
	if(i==2)then
		if(IsUnitAliveBJ(u) and j==2)then
			call SetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A10A',1)
			if GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A10B') <= 0 then
				call UnitAddAbility(u,'A10B')
			endif
			call SetUnitState(u,UNIT_STATE_LIFE,GetUnitState(u,UNIT_STATE_MAX_LIFE))
		endif
	else
		call UnitRemoveAbility(u,'A09L')
		call UnitRemoveAbility(u,'A10A')
	endif
	call DestroyEffect(AddSpecialEffectTarget("Abilities\\Spells\\Items\\AIvi\\AIviTarget.mdl",u,"origin"))
endfunction

handlers.name: Xd
handlers.body:
function Xd takes unit u returns boolean
	if(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A10A')>0)then
		call Vd(u)
		return true
	elseif(GetUnitTypeId(u)=='n01T')then
		if(GetRandomInt(0,99)<60)then
			call Ed(u)
			return true
		else
			return false
		endif
	endif
	return GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A070')>0
endfunction

function dF takes nothing returns nothing
local player p=GetOwningPlayer(kv)
local real x=GetUnitX(Kv)
local real y=GetUnitY(Kv)
local real sx=GetUnitX(kv)
local real sy=GetUnitY(kv)
local unit c=CreateUnit(p,'h09Q',sx,sy,.0)
local unit t
if(ni)then
call II("SE:MC:SG "+GetUnitName(kv)+" ->[no target]")
call NI()
endif
call IssuePointOrderById(c,$D0010,x,y)
call UnitApplyTimedLife(c,'BTLF',3.)
set sx=sx-(x)
set sy=sy-(y)
call TriggerSleepAction(SquareRoot(sx*sx+sy*sy)/ 700.)
set c=CreateUnit(p,'e008',x,y,.0)
call UnitAddAbility(c,'A09E')
call IssueImmediateOrderById(c,$D0080)
call UnitApplyTimedLife(c,'BTLF',3.)
set Bv=p
call GroupEnumUnitsInRange(Nv,x,y,300.,zo)
loop
set t=FirstOfGroup(Nv)
exitwhen t==null
call GroupRemoveUnit(Nv,t)
set sx=GetUnitState(t,UNIT_STATE_MANA)
if(sx>.0)then
set sy=RMinBJ(sx,'d')
call SetUnitState(t,UNIT_STATE_MANA,sx-sy)
call DestroyEffect(AddSpecialEffectTarget("Abilities\\Spells\\Human\\Feedback\\SpellBreakerAttack.mdl",t,"origin"))
call UnitDamageTarget(c,t,sy,true,false,ATTACK_TYPE_CHAOS,DAMAGE_TYPE_NORMAL,WEAPON_TYPE_WHOKNOWS)
endif
endloop
set c=null
set t=null
endfunction

function DF takes nothing returns nothing
	local player p=GetOwningPlayer(kv)
	local real sx=GetUnitX(kv)
	local real sy=GetUnitY(kv)
	local real r=GetRandomReal(70.,300.)
	local real y=GetRandomReal(.0,360.)*bj_DEGTORAD
	local real x=sx+r*Cos(y)
	local unit c=CreateUnit(p,'h09M',sx,sy,.0)
	if(ni)then
		call II("SE:MC:SM "+GetUnitName(kv)+" ->[no target]")

	endif
	set y=sy+r*Sin(y)
	call IssuePointOrderById(c,$D0010,x,y)
	call UnitApplyTimedLife(c,'BTLF',3.)
	call TriggerSleepAction(r/ 700.)
	call CreateUnit(p,'n025',x,y,.0)
	set c=null
endfunction
